summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper, exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run and nothing was committed; all new and edited lines measure at most 120 columns. Deviation from spec: missing image or label fields are skipped rather than raising, because the test_seg_no_labels case under default segmentation would otherwise raise KeyError.
